what: Fourteen work cards stick in turn at the top margin of the screen (sticky). For each card, from when its top edge touches the top of the screen until it has scrolled its own height, it shrinks from 1 to .9 with its top edge as the pivot while brightness goes from 100% to 20% (scrub 1.5, power1.out) — the next card covers it, so earlier cards stack like dark stairs. The photo inside a card shrinks from 1.2 to 1 from when the card enters from the bottom until it is fully visible (scrub 1)

options.scrub: Delay for the card to follow (sec), default 1.5
options.zoom: Photo initial size, default 1.2 · zoom-scrub default 1
options.--fx-top: Where the cards sit (css), default outer margin clamp(24px, …, 80px)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (If any) Photo in the card that shrinks from 1.2 → 1

note: The original ScrollTrigger sets no end, so the default (bottom top) applies — as long as the card height. On phones the original cards stand at more than twice the screen height minus margin
